historicalScenarioRecord.note: This section preserves historical measurement and rejected decision history only. The canonical current-certification authority is scenario-manifest.json, where none of these six scenarios appears.

scenarios.title: A frequency is established
gherkin: Given repeated identical runs under the system-chrome project at six workers
When the runs complete
Then the proportion exhibiting a force-killed worker is recorded
And the record states the number of runs it is based on
formerLinkedTests: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-013 the combined total is the sum of two independent settlements
tests/lifetime-tax-read-bound.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-021-01 a declared pack whose origin never responds reaches a terminal display state within the declared bound and names the document
scenarios.rejectionRationale: This scenario records a past frequency sample. Its page-test carriers do not assert process-level frequency and cannot serve as current persistent coverage.

scenarios.title: A concurrency threshold is probed
gherkin: Given runs at increasing worker counts
When each completes
Then the lowest worker count at which the stall was observed is recorded
And a count at which it was not observed is recorded as not-observed rather than as safe
formerLinkedTests: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-014 the combined curve attributes every step to a named jurisdiction
tests/lifetime-tax-read-bound.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-021-02 a declared pack delayed below the bound settles with every figure identical to the undelayed settlement
scenarios.rejectionRationale: This scenario records a past worker-count sweep. Its page-test carriers do not assert process-level threshold behavior and cannot serve as current persistent coverage.

scenarios.title: Repeated runs exit zero
gherkin: Given the selected remedy is applied
When the ninety-four-test set runs repeatedly at the chosen worker count
Then every run exits zero
And no run reports a worker that did not exit within its teardown budget
formerLinkedTests: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-013 the combined total is the sum of two independent settlements
tests/lifetime-tax-read-bound.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-021-05 the refusing side of the bound is pinned: a withheld pack is abandoned by name rather than waited on
scenarios.rejectionRationale: The former two-worker route produced provisional clean runs, but the exact current BUG-022 C03 workload later failed twice after all 94 tests passed. Those later failures reject this route as current closure without rewriting the earlier observations.

scenarios.title: Browser processes are released
gherkin: Given a run has completed
When the browser process count is sampled
Then it has returned to its pre-run level
formerLinkedTests: tests/lifetime-tax-combined.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-022-014 the combined curve is reachable by keyboard and has a text equivalent table
tests/lifetime-tax-read-bound.spec.mjs#Regression: SCN-021-04 the tolerated side of the bound is pinned: a pack delayed below the bound is served rather than aborted
scenarios.rejectionRationale: The former process samples remain historical evidence, but the later two-worker force-kill recurrence disproves their use as a current release guarantee. SCN-BUG017-11 owns the selected-route lifecycle result.

scenarios.title: The focused lifecycle boundary survives the strict canary
gherkin: Given the system-chrome project is configured with two workers on macOS
And Foundation receives an automatic worker-scoped boundary fixture
And Foundation closes its owned browser in its existing afterAll
When the cumulative Foundation-to-Paths canary runs in a child process
Then all 27 tests pass
And the child exits zero within 15 seconds of worker stop
And no worker force-kill or ignored teardown error is reported
scenarios.rejectionRationale: The strict canary produced an earlier GREEN and a discriminating close-removal RED, then failed twice at unchanged candidate bytes during finalization. The candidate was explicitly reverted and hash-verified against its baseline.

scenarios.title: The lifecycle candidate clears the blocked complete workload
gherkin: Given SCN-BUG017-09 has passed without an ignored lifecycle error
When the exact BUG-022 C03 94-test portfolio command runs at two workers
Then all 94 tests pass and the command exits zero
And no worker remains until the 300000ms force-kill boundary
And no Chrome process started by the workload remains after exit
scenarios.rejectionRationale: The two-worker complete workload passed provisionally, but selection required the strict lifecycle canary to remain green. Its later repeated failures rejected the candidate, after which the candidate was rolled back and SCN-BUG017-11 selected.
